title: The Basie band of 1944 and its trumpet section
summary: Jones says he stayed with Basie until September 1944 and names Joe Newman, Ed Lewis, Harry Edison and Al Killian at the Lincoln Hotel.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Yes, it was beautiful. So go back up to about 1940. What was your scene in the 40's? When did you go in the Army?
I went in the Army in 1944, September.
You were with Basie until you went in the Army, huh?
Who was in that band up to '44? Who were the trumpets in there then? Was Shad [Collins] there then?
The trumpet? No, no, no, Shad had long gone. That was Joe Newman, because Joe Newman replaced Buck Clayton because Buck had gone into the Army.
When did Buck go into the Army?
He went in the Army the first part of '44... or the latter of '43...
Then Joe Newman replaced Buck Clayton, is that right?
Yes, we were at the Lincoln Hotel and Joe had pneumonia.
What was another trumpet player; who else was in there?
Oh, Ed Lewis was in there then?
Harry Edison and Al Killian. We were in the Blue Room, at the Lincoln Hotel.
